Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks

Class ServerLifecycle

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.ServerLifecycle
public final class ServerLifecycle extends Object
Shared server-session policy, login synchronization, and cleanup, accessed on the server thread.

  • Method Details

    • starting

      public static void starting()
      Clears queued galleries, rotation-sound pacing, synchronized gesture state, and set-aside reports for a new server session. The loader must separately initialize its world policy before players log in.

    • stopped

      public static void stopped()
      Clears galleries, gesture state, and set-aside reports and releases world policy, its saver, and derived admission sets after server shutdown. Loader-owned cleanup remains the loader's responsibility.

    • reportSavedItems

      public static void reportSavedItems(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos, StackItemStorage.LoadResult result)
      Logs saved item stacks a block kept aside because they could not be read. A location is reported the first time in a session, and again whenever a load sets new entries aside.

    • login

      public static void login(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer player)
      Sends the current policy snapshot to this player. World policy must already be initialized.

    • logout

      public static void logout(UUID playerId)
      Removes this player's rotation-sound pacing and synchronized mode/modifier state.

    • refreshCommands

      public static void refreshCommands(net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer server, ServerConfig.Settings previous)
      Refreshes command availability only when gallery access changed.

    • syncAllPlayers

      public static int syncAllPlayers(net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer server)
      Sends one snapshot of the current policy to every player; policy files are not reread.
